pairing: Img_F against each target independently; no previous target solution or temporal state
pipeline: frozen image-only confirmation and propagation; no learned residual; local zero-mean normalized cross correlation; shared prefit; deferred rotations; batched confirmation
mask: Exclude 4-connected components of exact background intensity of at least 128 pixels, from reference only. Smaller islands at this quantized speckle intensity are not holes.
acceptance_interpretation: numerical only until exact matching displacement data and coordinate map validated
max_interpretation: largest tested target satisfying coverage, separately contiguous tested prefix; not strain percentage and not accuracy proof
followup: denser independent target testing near loss of acceptance; no changes to solver thresholds
truth_problem: 51 quarter-cross mesh states vs 191 perforated-plate image states; no formula for ClosedFormExpression; no index/unit/map inferred
preflight: Initial exact-intensity closing left one admissible FEA support because speckle quantization creates isolated background-valued pixels; aborted, retained in mask_preflight, excluded from qualification.

secondary_comparator.method: axis-aligned material silhouette extent ratios, no learned matcher, followed by same solver confirmation and propagation
secondary_comparator.levels: all 191 FEA and all 500 ClosedFormExpression targets independently
secondary_comparator.specific_assumption: complete constant-background object with axis-aligned deformation envelope; not valid for arbitrary occlusion, rotation or cropping
secondary_comparator.timing: reference preprocessing reused; target states reset; no previous pair parameters
secondary_comparator.decision: compare with learned proposal failure without retuning its weights or acceptance thresholds
secondary_comparator.truth: image-derived bounding box is never used as ground truth or to score displacement error
secondary_comparator.support_rationale: 64 px full-support ROI leaves 3 material windows in FEA. Separate 32 px supports with 32 px stride evaluate spatial detail; never pool their denominators or change 64 px results.

identity_control: level 0 means reference compared with itself; zero truth is known only for this diagnostic
identity_border_observation: 64 px strip identity control accepts 98/128 mask-admissible windows. Not an accuracy ceiling for other transforms, which move image-edge supports differently.
followup_reason: Level 34 rejected but 35 and 40 accepted: do not use bisection or assume monotonicity.
